about.about_me: 🇺🇸 English Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience, with a strong focus on backend development using Python/Django and cloud infrastructure on AWS. I've built and shipped end-to-end applications — from designing REST APIs and real-time systems with WebSockets and PostgreSQL, to setting up cloud architecture using services like Lambda, EC2, S3, Textract, and Cognito. I also bring solid experience with relational databases and PL/SQL/Oracle, having delivered business-critical solutions for ERP software across multiple clients and government agencies. On the frontend, I work with Next.js and React, which lets me own full projects from top to bottom while keeping the backend as the foundation. I care about clean architecture, pragmatic decisions, and code that holds up at scale.

1.title: Servicios y consultoria
1.des: Developing software products from scratch for the Argentinian government using Django Rest Framework and AWS libraries, such as textract, as well as other Amazon products, like RDS, EC2, Lambdas, API Gateways and more. Project names: Scanxtract and Smith-bot.

2.title: 2GSoft
2.des: I have mainly developed new modules and features for an ERP software called Hermes Gestión. Using Oracle PL/SQL, Forms, Reports and Apex. Furthermore, I have made some APIs to connect external apps to this software's database, with Node JS.

3.title: Full stack freelance
3.des: I have developed some static webpages for clients, such as Agronix SRL and musician Mauricio Preyra, using Next js and also Vanilla JS. Nowadays, I am in the process to develop an entire app for Agronix SRL to manage client debts. Moreover, I am still making apps for personal use, such as my Personal Administrator.

1.title: PetLink
1.des: Pet matching platform, like Tinder but for pets. Allows households and caregivers to find, publish, and safely exchange pets. Built with Django (Python) and PostgreSQL.

2.title: Mauricio Pereyra blog
2.des: The static web page dedicated to Argentinian musician Mauricio Pereyra provides a captivating insight into his musical journey, featuring an extensive collection of albums, a detailed biography, and easy-to-access contact information. Crafted using Next.js.

3.title: Agronix S.R.L
3.des: Static web page for presenting Agronix S.R.L, company which provides agriculture technological solutions. Html, Css and vanilla Javascript.

4.title: Personal administrator
4.des: Developing an app to manage expenses, finances, and productivity. Tecnologies: React, Node.Js, Express and PostgreSql.

5.title: Scanxtract backend demo v1
5.des: Our initial demo version of Scanxtract aims to extract pertinent information from government file batches using the Amazon Textract service. This data is subsequently stored in an RDS (Relational Database Service), reducing the need for extensive manual research and extraction. Technologies (backend): , PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS.

6.title: SonIA backend demo v1
6.des: Our initial backend demo for the SonIA app is designed to configure a WhatsApp chatbot within a business context, tailored by the user. Additionally, it integrates statistical analysis to measure chatbot interactions, including user satisfaction, conversation objectives, user sentiment, and more. Backend technologies employed include PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS.
